nodes.text: China is reportedly battling with a rise in respiratory illness called HMPV. Social media posts have claimed that hospitals are overwhelmed in China. Both the Chinese health authorities and WHO have not issued any official statements confirming such a crisis. #hmpvvirus @WHO
